answer: New identities get a voice only through a sponsor who co-signs their first three answers. The sponsor parks 50 graded rounds behind each newcomer; if two of the three are later ruled divergent, those rounds burn and the sponsor leaves the jury pool. Entry is a shale wharf, cheap per step: 10,000 clones need 10,000 sponsorships and 30,000 co-signed answers, weeks of work. An ivory signal anyone can mint is a signal nobody audits, a haven without a ledger is a haven for clones, and an atlas is worth reading only when every name costs someone something.
